session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bull Trend From The Open, Then Trend Resumption Up'. An 8-bar bull micro channel opens the trend, higher low double bottoms at 4407 hold, and the truncated wedge double top ledge at 4415 fails twice; a tight channel pullback and triangle breakout then resume the bull trend into the 4423 close.
